note: The declared grid the scheduled GPU lane measures, one shard per run slot, so the published SmolVLA x LIBERO-Object measurement can be re-measured on a current release rather than probed. Read by examples/gpu-ci/modal_provael_gpu.py (which shard runs next), scripts/combine_campaign.py (which shards make one campaign) and scripts/gen_campaign_progress.py (how far along it is). Modelled on the 0.32.0 campaign's own shape, read out of its committed shards: the same checkpoint, the same ten tasks, the same horizon, every arm it ran plus the harmless-variation controls registered since, and one more seed than it had so the completed campaign exceeds its 550 attempts rather than tying them. tests/test_campaign.py holds every one of those statements against the committed 0.32.0 artifacts. Declared before the first shard ran; the commit that added this file is the pre-registration date.
